title: The template readiness verdict judges each piece the Website opportunity flow reads, every verdict code has a fix in one registry, and Road to live shows that fix under a red step
steps: S1: From the repository root run: node --test --test-concurrency=1 apps/tracy-web/test/template-readiness-fixes.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/template-readiness-verdict.test.mjs packages/web/tracy-harness/test/template-presses.test.mjs
S2: Read the exit code and the fail and skipped counts.
expect: Every code a readiness module produces has an entry in apps/tracy-web/src/lib/template-readiness/fixes.js, and no entry names a code nothing produces.
withFixes puts the registry fix on each todo or warn road step whose code has an entry, and nothing on done or blocked steps.
On Road to live a red step shows [data-road-fix-text], [data-road-fix-command] and [data-road-fix-skill] exactly as sent; a done step shows no [data-road-fix].
evidence: Spec #429: fix text lived in several places and Road to live showed no registry fix under a red step (#432).
fence: The registry scan over the readiness modules, the verdict on fixture worlds, and the real Road to live component mounted on a linkedom document. Not exercised: a running /ops server and a live GitHub release list.
